title: Appleman and a Sheet of Paper
statementMd:
Appleman has a very big sheet of paper. This sheet has a form of rectangle with dimensions $1 × *n*$. Your task is help Appleman with folding of such a sheet. Actually, you need to perform $*q*$ queries. Each query will have one of the following types:

1. Fold the sheet of paper at position $*p*_{*i*}$. After this query the leftmost part of the paper with dimensions $1 × *p*_{*i*}$ must be above the rightmost part of the paper with dimensions $1 × ([*current* *width* *of* *sheet*] - *p*_{*i*})$.
2. Count what is the total width of the paper pieces, if we will make two described later cuts and consider only the pieces between the cuts. We will make one cut at distance $*l*_{*i*}$ from the left border of the current sheet of paper and the other at distance $*r*_{*i*}$ from the left border of the current sheet of paper.

Please look at the explanation of the first test example for better understanding of the problem.

## Input

The first line contains two integers: $*n*$ and $*q*$ ($1  ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}; 1 ≤ *q* ≤ 10^{5}$) — the width of the paper and the number of queries.

Each of the following $*q*$ lines contains one of the described queries in the following format:

- "$1$ $*p*_{*i*}$" $(1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} < [*current* *width* *of* *sheet*])$ — the first type query.
- "$2$ $*l*_{*i*}$ $*r*_{*i*}$" $(0 ≤ *l*_{*i*} < *r*_{*i*} ≤ [*current* *width* *of* *sheet*])$ — the second type query.

## Output

For each query of the second type, output the answer.

## Note

The pictures below show the shapes of the paper during the queries of the first example:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c9f6bae7ad494a5c75fad5240336e8bdecea2589.png)

After the first fold operation the sheet has width equal to $4$, after the second one the width of the sheet equals to $2$.
statementZhMd:
Appleman 有一张非常大的纸。这张纸是一个尺寸为 $1 × *n*$ 的矩形。你的任务是帮助 Appleman 折叠这张纸。实际上，你需要执行 $*q*$ 次查询。每次查询属于以下类型之一：

1. 在位置 $*p*_{*i*}$ 处折叠纸张。执行此查询后，尺寸为 $1 × *p*_{*i*}$ 的纸张左侧部分必须位于尺寸为 $1 × ([*current* *width* *of* *sheet*] - *p*_{*i*})$ 的纸张右侧部分上方。
2. 计算纸张碎片的总宽度：在纸张上进行下面所述的两次切割，并且只考虑两次切割之间的纸张碎片。第一次切割的位置距离当前纸张左边界 $*l*_{*i*}$，第二次切割的位置距离当前纸张左边界 $*r*_{*i*}$。

请查看第一个样例的解释，以便更好地理解题意。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数：$*n*$ 和 $*q*$（$1  ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}; 1 ≤ *q* ≤ 10^{5}$），分别表示纸张的宽度和查询次数。

接下来的 $*q*$ 行中的每一行包含以下格式所描述的一种查询：

- "$1$ $*p*_{*i*}$"（$1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} < [*current* *width* *of* *sheet*]$）——第一类查询。
- "$2$ $*l*_{*i*}$ $*r*_{*i*}$"（$0 ≤ *l*_{*i*} < *r*_{*i*} ≤ [*current* *width* *of* *sheet*]$）——第二类查询。

## 输出格式

对于每个第二类查询，输出答案。

## 说明

下面的图片展示了第一个样例中执行第一类查询期间纸张的形状：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c9f6bae7ad494a5c75fad5240336e8bdecea2589.png)

第一次折叠操作后，纸张的宽度变为 $4$；第二次折叠操作后，纸张的宽度变为 $2$。
